tasks.title: Promote and apply the Permission-catalogue migration granting USERS:* to existing Warehouse Managers
tasks.dod: The staged migration is promoted to live apps/server/migrations/, applies and reverts cleanly, and an integration check confirms every existing warehouse_manager Role holds all four USERS:* permissions after up and none of the three new ones after down.

tasks.title: Promote shared email/password validation and hashing to shared/domain/security
tasks.dod: Email/password value objects, predicates, and scrypt hashing move to shared/domain/security with zero behavior change; auth's existing test suite (moved alongside) stays green; auth imports from the new shared location.

tasks.title: Add users domain errors and invariant predicates
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover self-action, protected-Manager-target, Permission-exceeded-target (creation and credential-change directions), and reserved-Role-selection predicates in isolation; users/domain has no NestJS, HTTP, or TypeORM imports.

tasks.title: Add MemberLifecycleRepository
tasks.dod: Repository integration tests against PostgreSQL cover lockMembership (including cross-Warehouse scoping), findRoleGrantedPermissionIds, insertMembership, and deleteMembership.

tasks.title: Extend AuthenticationRepository with identity-lifecycle and bulk session operations
tasks.dod: Repository integration tests cover createIdentity (no Session row), updateEmail, updateCredential, revokeSessionsByAccountId (asserting only the target account's Sessions move), deleteSessionsByAccountId, and deleteIdentity, in the deletion-sequencing order data-model.md specifies.

tasks.title: Add persistence-entity test factories
tasks.dod: accountEntityFactory, userEntityFactory, warehouseMembershipEntityFactory, and sessionEntityFactory each build a valid DeepPartial entity respecting existing invariants, using only synthetic example.test data.

tasks.title: Add users contracts and extend shared-types PermissionId/ErrorCode
tasks.dod: packages/contracts/users exports strict Zod request/response schemas for create/email-change/password-change/delete matching contracts/openapi.yaml; packages/shared-types PermissionId gains USERS_EMAIL_UPDATE, USERS_PASSWORD_CHANGE, USERS_DELETE matching the migration's catalogue IDs byte-for-byte, and ErrorCode gains this feature's new stable error codes.

tasks.title: Grant the new Permissions to future Warehouse Managers via provision-initial-access
tasks.dod: An integration test registering a new Warehouse after this change confirms its Warehouse Manager Role holds all four USERS:* Permissions immediately, with no reliance on the T1 migration.

tasks.title: Implement CreateMemberCommand
tasks.dod: Command integration tests cover the happy path, invalid email/password, duplicate email, missing/cross-Warehouse Role, reserved-Role selection, Role exceeding the actor's Permissions, atomic rollback on injected failure, and that a created member can sign in with the initial credentials via the existing unchanged sign-in command.

tasks.title: Implement ChangeMemberEmailCommand
tasks.dod: Command integration tests cover the happy path (target Sessions left active), invalid/duplicate email, cross-Warehouse/missing target, self-targeting, protected-Manager target, and target-exceeds-actor's-Permissions denials, plus atomic rollback on injected failure. The missing-Permission denial (AC-10) is guard-level and is not this task's concern.

tasks.title: Implement ChangeMemberPasswordCommand
tasks.dod: Command integration tests cover the happy path (every prior target Session revoked, verified via revokeSessionsByAccountId's returned count), invalid password length, cross-Warehouse/missing target, self-targeting, protected-Manager target, and target-exceeds-actor's-Permissions denials, plus atomic rollback on injected failure. The missing-Permission denial (AC-10) is guard-level and is not this task's concern.

tasks.title: Implement DeleteMemberCommand
tasks.dod: Command integration tests cover the happy path (target's Sessions, Membership, Account, and User all gone, email free for reuse, in the data-model deletion-sequencing order), cross-Warehouse/missing target, self-deletion, protected-Manager target, and a concurrent TransferWarehouseManagerCommand-vs-delete race that leaves the Warehouse with exactly one Manager, plus atomic rollback on injected failure. The missing-Permission denial (AC-10) is guard-level and is not this task's concern.

tasks.title: Add UsersController REST endpoints and wire the users module
tasks.dod: REST contract tests confirm every endpoint validates the shared Zod schemas, maps each command's denials to stable error codes, and denies a missing Permission and a cross-Warehouse target without disclosing existence; the existing authorization-coverage architecture scan is extended to UsersController and confirms every handler is Permission-gated and Warehouse-scoped; UsersModule is registered in AppModule and users imports no access/* or auth/* feature-owned file.

tasks.title: Extend the access member-list read path with email
tasks.dod: list-access-members.query.ts / AccessReadRepository.listMembersAndAssignments returns each member's normalized email via the existing accounts.user_id join, and packages/contracts/access's AccessMemberRead schema gains the email field, with an integration test asserting the new field on an existing fixture.

tasks.title: Add a load smoke test for the four lifecycle endpoints
tasks.dod: An automated load smoke test sustains ≥30 operations/second per instance for 10 minutes across create/email-change/password-change/delete and reports p95 latency against spec.md §6's 400ms/300ms/300ms/500ms targets.

tasks.title: Add users endpoints to the RTK Query API slice and mutation hook handlers
tasks.dod: access-api.ts exposes createMember/changeMemberEmail/changeMemberPassword/deleteMember mutations with invalidation tags covering the member list and current-access projection; useAccessAdministrationActions.ts gains matching handlers following the existing success/field-error mapping pattern, covered by unit tests.

tasks.title: Build the Members list and wire the Members tab, including delete
tasks.dod: MemberList/MemberRow render per the approved design handoff (node e4e0H), replacing MemberRoleActions/MembersDatasetCard in the Members tab; the protected Warehouse Manager row and the actor's own row render a status chip instead of action controls; per-row and "Create member" actions are enabled only for Permissions the actor holds; delete asks for confirmation via the existing DeletionDialog shell and the list refetches after every mutation; component tests cover loading/empty/protected-row/self-row/denied states.

tasks.title: Build the Create Member dialog
tasks.dod: A Create Member modal/sheet collects email, initial password, and an existing Role, submits via the new mutation, and surfaces field-level validation, duplicate-email, Permission-exceeded, and reserved-Role-selection errors per the approved design handoff; component tests cover success and each error state.

tasks.title: Build the Edit-email and Reset-password dialogs
tasks.dod: Edit-email and reset-password dialogs reuse the existing RoleDialog shell, submit via their respective mutations, and surface validation, duplicate-email (email only), protected-Manager, and Permission-exceeded-target errors per the approved design handoff; component tests cover success and each error state.
